instructorInfo.name: Om Naganath Sapar
instructorInfo.tagline: Every second counts in an emergency. That's why I teach rescue skills to everyday people.
instructorInfo.bio:
Hi, I’m Om Naganath Sapar of ITUS (Indian Rescue Academy)

Every second counts in an emergency. That’s why I teach rescue skills to everyday people.

At ITUS (Indian Rescue Academy), we run hands-on rescue training programs to help individuals, schools, and organizations respond confidently when it matters most.
From first aid and CPR to fire safety and disaster response. My goal is to put life-saving skills in more hands.

On this site you’ll find our training programs, safety resources and much more.

Because heroes aren’t born. They’re trained.
Let’s start.

subjects.title: Disaster Management
subjects.description: Preparing for and responding to natural and man-made disasters, conducting safety audits, and emergency drill execution.

subjects.title: Boat Paddling (IRB)
subjects.description: Mastering paddle synchronization, river/flood navigation, and team-based paddling in Inflatable Rescue Boats.

subjects.title: Boat Handling (IRB)
subjects.description: Technical maneuvering, motor rescue operations, and maintenance of Inflatable Rescue Boats during flood rescue missions.

subjects.title: CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation)
subjects.description: Life-saving emergency procedures including high-quality chest compressions, rescue breathing, and AED operation.

subjects.title: Bandages & First Aid
subjects.description: Applying emergency pressure bandages, splinting fractures, and managing head/spinal injuries during trauma.

subjects.title: Victim Carrying Techniques
subjects.description: Mastering single-rescuer and multi-rescuer carry styles, improvised stretchers, and rapid extraction methods.

subjects.title: Knots & Rope Rigging
subjects.description: Tying essential safety and rigging knots (bowline, clove hitch, figure-eight) for climbing, anchoring, and haulage.

subjects.title: Basic Fire Fighting
subjects.description: Understanding combustion classes, deploying fire extinguishers (CO2, DCP), and executing safety evacuation drills.

subjects.title: Wading Techniques
subjects.description: Safe foot-crossing methods in fast-flowing water channels, forming wading chains, and overcoming flood currents.

testimonials.name: Akash Shinde
testimonials.feedback: Om Sir's IRB boat handling and water safety instruction was top-notch. He explains safety checks so clearly that everyone felt completely secure. The hands-on drills were excellent.

testimonials.name: Sneha Patil
testimonials.feedback: The CPR and emergency bandage training organized by Om Sir was highly practical. We learned real life-saving skills and built actual confidence to handle emergency situations.

testimonials.name: Dr. R. K. Joshi
testimonials.feedback: Om Naganath Sapar has demonstrated exemplary dedication during our Disaster Risk Reduction events. His discipline, root understanding of geography, and leadership skills make him an outstanding trainer.
